prompt: Build a small analytics dashboard: a web page that shows event counts, fed by a JSON API. Provide an executable start.sh at the repository root that starts the server listening on the port given by the PORT environment variable (bind 127.0.0.1 or 0.0.0.0). Keep all state in memory; no external database or network service. If dependencies are needed, provide a setup.sh at the root that installs them. Request and response bodies are JSON unless stated otherwise. GET / serves the dashboard HTML (text/html) with an element whose id is summary where the counts are displayed. POST /api/events with {"type"} returns 201; a missing type returns 400. GET /api/summary returns {"total":<n>,"by_type":{<type>:<count>}} and is {"total":0,"by_type":{}} before any events.

hidden.run: if [ -f setup.sh ]; then sh setup.sh; fi; python3 tests_hidden/test_qs.py
